records.claim: Some older product labels for fluoxetine recommend that women who are breastfeeding not use this medication. More recent product labels do not include this recommendation. The benefit of treating your condition might outweigh possible risks of untreated illness. Your healthcare providers can talk with you about using fluoxetine and what treatment is best for you. Be sure to talk to your healthcare provider about all your breastfeeding questions.
